sloka: इहस्थां मां न जानीते शङ्के लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।जानन्नपि हि तेजस्वी धर्षणं मर्षयिष्यति ।। ५.२६.१९।।।।
transliteration: ihasthāṁ māṁ na jānīte śaṅke lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।jānannapi hi tejasvī dharṣaṇaṁ marṣayiṣyati ।। 5.26.19।।।।

translations.english: "The elder brother of Lakshamana does not know that I am here. Or, I'm afraid, the glorious Rama knows and yet tolerates such an outrageous act.
